name: bus-diagram
description: Instructional diagrams of KNX installations, with a limited simulation layer.
author: Yoann Maurel

scripts.preversion: node scripts/release-version.mjs --preflight && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.build: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/verify-build.mjs && node site/samples/extensions/build.mjs && node scripts/copy-demo-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src/knx src/ui src/equipment src/i18n src/core.ts src/index.ts tests/knx tests/e2e/demo.spec.ts tests/e2e/lifecycle.spec.ts tests/e2e/site.spec.ts site site/samples/extensions scripts/sync-scenarios.mjs scripts/copy-demo-assets.mjs scripts/build-site.mjs scripts/build-notices.mjs scripts/notices.mjs scripts/install-hook.mjs scripts/site-data.mjs scripts/site-reference.mjs scripts/validate.mjs scripts/check-version.mjs scripts/release-version.mjs scripts/llm-reference.mjs eleventy.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src/knx src/ui src/equipment src/i18n site src/core.ts src/index.ts tests/knx tests/e2e/demo.spec.ts tests/e2e/lifecycle.spec.ts site/samples/extensions scenarios
scripts.test:e2e: npm run sync && npm run build && playwright test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:version && npm run test && npm run build
